name: Employer / chief executive responsibility and delegated duties
condition: Identify the person with statutory responsibility. A section 16(2) assignment is conditional; do not treat delegation as removing the chief executive’s duty.

name: Health and safety representative
condition: OHS Act section 17 generally requires designation where an employer has more than 20 employees at a workplace. Assess the required numbers, workplace categories and consultation procedures; do not use the app’s 10-employee target market as this statutory threshold.

name: Health and safety committee members
condition: Assess whether two or more health and safety representatives are designated and the committee requirements that follow.

name: First aider
condition: Assess employee numbers, shifts, workplace risks and valid first-aid qualifications; identify all persons needed for coverage.

name: Fire and emergency coordinator
legalBasis: Applicable fire / emergency provisions and municipal fire bylaws
condition: Determine roles from the premises, emergency plan, occupancy, hazards and applicable local requirements.

name: Construction manager
condition: Construction work only; verify contractor responsibilities, competence and written appointment requirements.

name: Construction supervisor
condition: Construction work only; determine supervision needed for each work area and shift.

name: Construction health and safety officer
condition: Construction work only; assess project circumstances, applicable appointment requirements and registration.

name: Construction risk assessment competent person
condition: Construction work only; verify competence and risk assessment responsibilities.

name: Fall protection plan competent person
condition: Assess construction work exposing persons to a risk of falling and the fall protection plan requirements.

name: Scaffolding competent persons
condition: Where scaffolding is used; distinguish erection, supervision, inspection and other required roles.

name: Excavation competent person
condition: Where excavation work is performed; assess supervision and inspection responsibilities.

name: Lifting machinery inspection / examination competent persons
condition: Where lifting machinery or tackle is used; distinguish inspections, examinations and testing with required competence / registration.

name: Machinery supervision competent person
condition: Assess the machinery installation and the applicable supervision and designation requirements.

name: Hazardous chemical agent assessment competent person
condition: Where hazardous chemical agents are present; assess assessment, monitoring, training and specialist competence requirements.

name: Incident investigator
condition: Determine the employer’s incident recording and investigation responsibilities and the designated investigator.

name: Company health and safety policy
condition: Assess whether a written policy is required by direction; also record contractual or company policy requirements separately.

name: Standard risk assessment document
legalBasis: OHS Act, section 8 and applicable risk-specific regulations
condition: Document workplace hazards, exposure, controls and review arrangements under the rules applicable to the work.

name: Safe work procedures / method statements
legalBasis: OHS Act, section 8 and applicable regulations
condition: Identify procedures required by the work, equipment, substances and any construction activities.

name: Health and safety representative designation records
condition: Where representatives are required; retain applicable designation and consultation records.

name: HSE committee minutes
condition: Where a committee is required; record membership, meetings, recommendations and follow-up.

name: First-aid certificates and first-aid provision records
condition: Assess required first aid provision, qualified persons, certificate validity and equipment.

name: Emergency plan, evacuation arrangements and drill records
legalBasis: Applicable emergency provisions and municipal fire bylaws
condition: Determine requirements for the premises, occupancy, hazards and local authority.

name: Fire equipment inspection / service records
legalBasis: Applicable fire equipment requirements and municipal fire bylaws
condition: Record equipment and inspection / service evidence required for the premises.

name: Employee induction and health and safety training records
legalBasis: OHS Act, section 13 and applicable regulations
condition: Identify information, instruction and training required for each job and hazard.

name: PPE assessment, issue and training records
legalBasis: OHS Act, section 8 and applicable PPE provisions
condition: Where PPE is required; document selection, provision, use, instruction and replacement arrangements.

name: Incident register, investigation and statutory reporting records
legalBasis: OHS Act, section 24; General Administrative Regulations, regulations 8–9
condition: Distinguish records retained from incidents that must be reported to the authorities.

name: Hazardous chemical inventory and safety data sheets
condition: Where hazardous chemical agents are present; verify current SDS, inventory and applicable exposure controls.

name: Medical surveillance / fitness evidence
legalBasis: Applicable exposure-specific regulations; Construction Regulations where relevant
condition: Only where required by work and exposure. Retain appropriate fitness evidence and protect confidential medical information.

name: Machinery, lifting equipment and inspection records
legalBasis: Applicable machinery regulations; Driven Machinery Regulations 2015
condition: Identify equipment-specific inspection, examination, testing and maintenance records.

name: Contractor health and safety agreements
legalBasis: OHS Act, section 37 and applicable construction provisions
condition: Assess contractor arrangements and duties; a section 37(2) agreement is not a blanket transfer of responsibility.

name: Construction health and safety plan and file
condition: Construction projects only; distinguish client, principal contractor and contractor documentation.

name: Construction notification / permit evidence
condition: Construction only; check current thresholds, project conditions and the responsible applicant.

name: Compensation Fund registration / letter of good standing
legalBasis: Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act; applicable contracting requirements
condition: Verify registration obligations and when a current letter is required by clients or contracts.

name: Workplace inspection sheets
legalBasis: OHS Act, section 8 and applicable equipment / workplace regulations
condition: Select inspection sheets and inspection frequencies for the premises, activities and equipment. Retain completed inspections, defects, corrective actions and sign-off.

name: Near-miss reports
legalBasis: Company incident prevention procedures; applicable incident reporting duties
condition: Record near misses, immediate controls, investigation and corrective actions. Determine separately whether an occurrence requires statutory reporting; a near-miss form does not replace statutory notifications.
